New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to get new episodes as soon as they're released.

Here are the stories we'll be discussing in this episode:

  • Apple posts Q3 2026 earnings: $109.4 billion in revenue, up 16% YoY
  • Apple Q3 2026 earnings are a mixed bag, stock down ~10% in pre-market trading
  • Apple warns supply constraints will be 'significant' next quarter
  • Tim Cook hosts his final earnings call as Apple CEO, confirms Ternus will take over future calls
  • App Store regulatory changes are starting to impact Apple Services growth
  • Apple's latest acquisition makes a lot of sense for its product roadmap
